body:
I noticed the glow from the ceiling lamp was unusually bright for such an early hour. My heart raced as I approached cautiously, my mind already plotting how best to address this issue. What if it wasn't just a temporary problem? Could there be something more serious going on?

I took a deep breath and said, "Excuse me, may I ask who last used this light?" The young choir director, who had been whispering into her phone, turned slightly embarrassed but remained silent.

"Can we talk about this?" I asked, my voice steady though my anger flared within me.
